सुमुख: सुमुख (1) a) OCIMUM BASILICUM LINN. (HK) = O. ALBUM LINN. (HK); b) [O. BASILICUM PILOSUM] (MW; PW); (2) O. GRATISSIMUM LINN. (शाल्मली) (Vśs: = मोचरस = शाल्मलीवेष्ट; (11) = कणगुग्गुलु (Vśs) = a) श्वेतजीरक (see जीरक) (Vśs); b) a partic. kind of गुग्गुलु (Vśs);
सौवीर: सौवीर(क) See कर्कन्धू̆, कोल, बदर। (1) ZIZYPHUS SATIVA GAERTN. (Dgv, nr. 84, = राजकोल = राज-बदर; V 1, p. 163) = Z. VULGARIS LAM. (Dgv, nr. 84; V 1, p. 163); (2) a) = कोल (HK); b) = बृहद्बदर (Vśs); J. J. Meyer, transl. Kauṭ., p. 141, note 8: Gaṇ. explains that कोल is the small, बदर the large and सौवीरक the sweet jujube. Ḍa. on Su.Sū. 46, 139: बदर is large, कोल is of a moderate size and कर्कन्धु is small; सौवीर is the largest (among the jujube-fruits) and is, both ripe and unripe, sweet.

BR. EX SIMS (Bpn, p. 265: acc. to others); (4) [MARSILEA QUADRIFOLIATA LINN.] (Bpn, p. 265); (5) MIMOSA PUDICA LINN. (KB 2, p. 915-917; PW; Vśs).
सिता: sitā (1) = kāṣṭhapāṭalā (Rā.nigh. 9, 152); (2) = śvetavacā (Indu on A.s.U. 42, 30 and 32 and 34); (3) = śvetadūrvā (Nś. 380ab). Cf. Rā.nigh., pariśiṣṭa, daśārthāḥ 1: sitā is a synonym of bākucī, dūrvā, (madya), dhātrī, kuṭumbinī, candrikā, priyā, piṅga, trāyamāṇā and tejinī.
